proposition: Nafsat I concedes Sufis are accused of two faults and answers the first: ecstatic utterances seizing on ‘Everything is God’ come from lazy people who have not passed beyond animal nature; real understanding takes years of discipline under a shaykh.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to the ruler who was judging him
Melvin-Koushki, The Quest for a Universal Science (Yale 2012)
